rich_description: The Institute of Mental Health (IMH) operates a 24-hour Mental Health Helpline at 6389-2222 that anyone in Singapore can call when they are worried about their own mental health or a loved one's. Trained mental health professionals assess the caller, give immediate practical advice, and connect callers to the most appropriate next step — IMH's outpatient clinic, the IMH Emergency Service (open 24/7 for acute psychiatric emergencies), a community mental health team via the Community Health Assessment Team (CHAT) for those aged 16-30, polyclinic mental health services, or a non-IMH community partner like the Samaritans (for emotional distress) or NAMS (for addiction-driven distress). The helpline is the right entry point for: feeling sad, low, hopeless, empty, or worthless for weeks or months at a time (depression); persistent severe anxiety, panic attacks, or fear that disables daily life; hearing voices, paranoid thoughts, or losing touch with reality; thinking about self-harm or suicide; bipolar mood swings; postpartum mental health concerns; or watching a relative refuse treatment but clearly deteriorate. Service is free; clinical follow-up at IMH or partner clinics is means-tested with MediShield, MediSave, and MediFund support available.

other_criteria: Open to anyone in Singapore — helpline is free and anonymous
Clinical follow-up at IMH outpatient or community partners is subsidised for citizens and PRs; foreigners pay non-subsidised rates
24/7 helpline at 6389-2222; IMH Emergency Service at Buangkok Green is also open 24/7 for walk-in psychiatric emergencies
Concerned family member can call without the patient's consent

required_documents.name: Referral letter
required_documents.required_if: if referred by polyclinic or GP

oth_location: IMH operates from Buangkok Green (10 Buangkok View). CHAT (the youth-focused arm) runs satellite sessions at *SCAPE and select Polyclinics. PLACEHOLDER — verify whether IMH community outreach runs at Tampines Polyclinic or Tampines OTH.

operating_hours.24-7: Mental Health Helpline 6389-2222 and IMH Emergency Service at Buangkok Green
operating_hours.sat-sun: closed (outpatient); helpline and Emergency Service always open

typical_processing_time: Helpline answered within minutes. First non-urgent outpatient appointment typically 2-6 weeks. Acute cases routed to IMH Emergency Service or admitted directly.
